therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adolescent subjects with restless legs syndrome (RLS) who completed the parent study SP1006
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs)

results.effect_size: 100% TEAE rate at 2 mg/24h final dose; 85.7% TEAE rate at 3 mg/24h final dose; 0% withdrawal due to TEAEs in both groups
subgroup_findings: Secondary efficacy outcomes (IRLS, CGI, RLS-6) not reportable due to N<3 in subgroups
safety_signals: 100% of participants in the Rotigotine 2 mg/24h final dose group experienced TEAEs
85.7% of participants in the Rotigotine 3 mg/24h final dose group experienced TEAEs
No TEAEs led to withdrawal of study medication in either group

context.duration: Up to 14 months (12 months treatment + safety follow-up)
context.investigator_commentary: Sponsor decision to terminate; not a safety decision

results_by_chain.endpoint: Percentage of participants with TEAEs (2 mg/24h final dose)
results_by_chain.population_description: Adolescents with restless legs syndrome who completed parent study SP1006, titrated to 2 mg/24h final dose

results_by_chain.endpoint: Percentage of participants with TEAEs (3 mg/24h final dose)
results_by_chain.population_description: Adolescents with restless legs syndrome who completed parent study SP1006, titrated to 3 mg/24h final dose
